description_full: Collective Mining Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties located in Colombia. The company explores gold, silver, copper, and tungsten deposits. It holds 100% interest in its flagship project The Guayabales project consisting of exploration titles, exploration applications, and mining concession option agreements and a number of surface rights option agreements. The Guayabales Project is located in the Middle Cauca belt in the Department of Caldas, Colombia. The company is headquartered in Miami, Florida.

financial_summary: Collective Mining Ltd. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $1.2B market cap.
Returns on capital run at -214% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $42M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, thin -48.1× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 11.9% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 43% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
